source: Panda Federation public catalog. Tool counts come from this file, not from page copy.

site.name: Panda Federation
site.description: Free public-data tools for AI agents: check references, find federal grants and bids, pull official lead lists and audit domains. On Apify and as MCP servers.

servers.name: Panda Research Tools
servers.description: 8 research-integrity tools: citation checks, OpenAlex and literature search, PubMed evidence tables, experts, PDF tables, Wayback snapshots and topic trends.

tools.name: citation_formatter
tools.title: Citation Generator API
tools.description: Turn DOIs, ISBNs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs or messy references into APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver, BibTeX or RIS.

tools.name: literature_search
tools.title: Google Scholar Scraper Alternative
tools.description: Find real scholarly papers on a topic, with citation counts, free PDF links, retraction flags and BibTeX.

tools.name: pdf_table_extractor
tools.title: PDF Table Extractor
tools.description: Extract every table in a PDF to Excel and CSV, with OCR for scanned pages.

tools.name: pubmed_evidence_table
tools.title: PubMed Scraper
tools.description: Build a screening-ready PubMed evidence table with study design, sample size, retraction status and PRISMA counts.

tools.name: reference_checker
tools.title: Reference Checker
tools.description: Check whether references, DOIs or paper titles are real, correctly cited and not retracted.

tools.name: researcher_expert_finder
tools.title: Google Scholar Author Alternative
tools.description: Rank academic experts and key opinion leaders for a research topic.

tools.name: wayback_snapshot_finder
tools.title: Wayback Machine Snapshot Finder
tools.description: Find Internet Archive CDX snapshot timestamps, archive URLs and first/last-seen dates for URLs or domains.

tools.name: topic_trends_tracker
tools.title: Topic Trends Tracker
tools.description: Measure public interest in topics over time from Wikipedia pageviews, with trend, peaks and an interest index.

servers.name: Panda Public Funding Tools
servers.description: 10 public-funding tools: grants, contracts, SAM.gov bids, SBIR/STTR, SEC financials, clinical trials, Federal Register, recalls, VIN decode and EU tenders.

tools.name: clinical_trial_leads
tools.title: Clinical Trial Leads
tools.description: Find ClinicalTrials.gov trials by condition, drug, sponsor, phase, status or location, with contacts and sites.

tools.name: federal_contract_finder
tools.title: USAspending Scraper
tools.description: Find US federal contract awards, incumbents and contracts ending soon by NAICS, PSC, agency, state or set-aside.

tools.name: federal_register_monitor
tools.title: Federal Register Monitor
tools.description: Watch new US federal rules, proposed rules and notices by keyword or agency, with comment deadlines.

tools.name: grants_finder
tools.title: Grants.gov Scraper
tools.description: Find open or upcoming US federal grant opportunities plus funded NIH and NSF awards.

tools.name: product_recall_monitor
tools.title: Product Recall Monitor
tools.description: Combine FDA and CPSC recalls in one feed, with product, hazard, firm, class and status.

tools.name: sbir_sttr_topic_radar
tools.title: SBIR/STTR Topic Radar
tools.description: Search open SBIR/STTR topics from every agency by keyword, with close dates and DoD Q&A.

tools.name: sec_financials_excel
tools.title: SEC Financials to Excel
tools.description: Pull standardized annual financials for US-listed companies from SEC EDGAR XBRL.

tools.name: vin_decoder_recalls
tools.title: VIN Decoder + Recalls
tools.description: Bulk-decode VINs with NHTSA vPIC and attach recall campaigns and complaint counts.

tools.name: sam_gov_opportunities

tools.name: eu_ted_tenders
tools.title: EU TED Tenders
tools.description: Search official EU TED public procurement notices by keyword, CPV, buyer country and date.

tools.name: company_hiring_signals

tools.name: trucking_company_leads
tools.title: Trucking Company Leads

servers.name: Panda Web Security Tools
servers.description: 7 site and email safety tools: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, AI/SEO audit, hidden-AI scanner, domain WHOIS/expiry, broken links, website change monitor and RSS feed monitor.

tools.name: ai_search_seo_audit
tools.title: AI Search & SEO Audit
tools.description: Score SEO and AI-search readiness for web pages, including crawler access, ranked fixes and an llms.txt draft.

tools.name: broken_link_checker
tools.title: Broken Link Checker
tools.description: Crawl start pages and report 404s, redirects and dead links with an Excel report.

tools.name: bulk_domain_whois_expiry
tools.title: Bulk Domain WHOIS & Expiry Checker

tools.name: hidden_ai_instructions_scanner

tools.name: rss_feed_monitor

tools.name: website_change_monitor
tools.title: Website Change Monitor

servers.name: Panda Federation Tools (umbrella)
servers.description: Index package for all 40 public-data tools across the four focused servers. Prefer a focused server unless an older config still loads the umbrella.

install.notes: The umbrella lists every tool when PFT_DOMAIN is unset, or one domain when PFT_DOMAIN is research, public-funding, leads or web-security. Prefer a focused server for new installs.

servers.name: Quiet File Team MCP
servers.description: Six free offline MCP tools that explain, configure and check a Quiet File Team. No network calls, no paid APIs, no disk reads of your machine.

install.notes: Python 3.11+ and uv. No APIFY_TOKEN. Use with the free Bash core or the paid setup kit.

tools.name: explain_method
tools.title: Explain method
tools.description: Explain Quiet File Team concepts and trust limits before an exercise. Offline; no network calls.

tools.name: generate_team_config
tools.title: Generate team config
tools.description: Return safe roster and zone defaults with a lead-only coordinator. Offline; no disk writes.

tools.name: generate_early_exit
tools.title: Generate early exit
tools.description: Draft a quoted early-exit block for a supplied role and path.

tools.name: validate_layout_manifest
tools.title: Validate layout manifest
tools.description: Compare supplied relative paths against the expected layout. It does not scan a real filesystem.

tools.name: draft_workflow
tools.title: Draft workflow
tools.description: Draft fictional practice steps for the default roster.

tools.name: draft_owner_batch
tools.title: Draft owner batch
tools.description: Deduplicate owner questions and keep unresolved task references.
